name: harness
description: Harness Engineering — solo-dev execution loop. First run: harness:install onboards L1 user-rules. harness:cycle starts an active cycle, then harness:plan → harness:work → harness:review keeps implementation inside approved spec/design/plan slices. Hooks block code outside active implementation/validation. Quality-floor: bar-lock + independent review gate + cross-cycle ratchet.
